low.label: Low
low.description: Minor physical injury unlikely or easily avoided.

high.label: High
high.description: Substantial risk of severe injury requiring urgent mitigation.

H01.name: slip_wet
H01.rationale: Loss of traction from moisture or loose rugs presents moderate slip risk.

H02.name: trip_clutter
H02.rationale: Obstacles and trailing cables in walkways pose stumbling hazards.

H03.name: electrical
H03.rationale: Exposed voltage, overloaded adapters, or damp sockets pose direct electric shock hazards.

H04.name: fire_heat
H04.rationale: Active burners, boiling liquids, and space heaters pose acute burn and ignition hazards.

H05.name: sharp_glass
H05.rationale: Exposed knives, razor blades, and glass shards can cause severe lacerations.

H06.name: fall_height
H06.rationale: Unguarded staircases, balconies, and steep drops carry high fall injury potential.

H07.name: unstable_falling
H07.rationale: Unanchored furniture and falling heavy items can cause blunt crush trauma.

H08.name: chemical_poison
H08.rationale: Domestic cleaning agents, unsealed medicines, and solvents carry toxic chemical risks.

H09.name: choking_small_objects
H09.rationale: Small objects pose baseline choking risks primarily for infants and toddlers.

H10.name: water_drowning
H10.rationale: Standing domestic water containers present submersion and drowning hazards.

H11.name: strangulation_entrapment
H11.rationale: Dangling cords and entrapment loops pose acute constriction hazards.

H12.name: structural_damage
H12.rationale: Cracked ceilings, loose railings, or sagging masonry can fail under load.

H13.name: poor_visibility
H13.rationale: Inadequate lighting and harsh glare obscure existing physical obstacles.

H14.name: outdoor_traffic_terrain
H14.rationale: Potholes, broken sidewalks, and vehicle thoroughfares cause outdoor trauma.

H15.name: other_observable
H15.rationale: Unclassified observable physical hazards assigned moderate baseline.

combination_rules.description: Electrical item or socket strip near a water source
combination_rules.rationale: Electrical equipment in close proximity to water dramatically escalates electric shock and electrocution hazard.

combination_rules.description: Flame or heat source near combustible materials
combination_rules.rationale: Open flame or high thermal output near combustible materials creates severe rapid fire ignition risk.

combination_rules.description: Tall unanchored furniture with baby or child present
combination_rules.rationale: Young children frequently climb furniture or open drawers, dramatically increasing fatal tip-over crush danger.

combination_rules.description: Staircase combined with poor visibility or darkness
combination_rules.rationale: Inadequate lighting on stairs severely impairs depth perception and tread edge recognition, multiplying fall severity.

combination_rules.description: Wet or slippery surface on stair treads
combination_rules.rationale: Moisture or loose mats on stairs causes sudden downward falls with severe kinetic impact.

combination_rules.description: Climbable furniture near balcony railing or window with child
combination_rules.rationale: Furniture positioned near railings or low windows provides stepping platforms for children, bypassing fall barriers.

combination_rules.description: Dangling cords or plastic packaging within reach of baby crib or bed
combination_rules.rationale: Cords or plastic packaging in infant sleeping areas present catastrophic strangulation and suffocation hazards.

combination_rules.description: Medicines or chemical cleaners on low surfaces within reach of child
combination_rules.rationale: Accessible pharmaceutical or chemical containers invite exploratory ingestion by young children.

evidence_gating_rules.description: Downgrades risk level to uncertain if hazard is only possible or evidence strength is weak.
evidence_gating_rules.rationale: Risk levels are auditable facts. Possible hazards or weak sightings cannot be classified as definitive Low/Medium/High without direct verification.

potential_level_rules.description: Calculates potential level for possible or weak items based on hypothetical confirmed score.

overall_risk_rules.description: Aggregates overall scene risk based strictly on verified observed and likely hazards.
logic: overall_risk is the maximum level among all hazards with status in ['observed', 'likely'].
If all candidate hazards have status == 'possible', overall_risk is 'uncertain'.
If no candidate hazards exist and perception succeeded with adequate coverage, overall_risk is 'low' and outcome is 'none_observed'.
If perception encountered heavy coverage gaps or unassessable image quality with no hazards detected, outcome is 'inconclusive'.

immediate_action_rules.description: Active visible fire, smoke, or uncontrolled combustion
immediate_action_rules.pattern: visible fire, open uncontrolled flame, or heavy smoke

action.banner_message: Possible fire or heavy smoke observed. Evacuate people immediately and contact local emergency services.

immediate_action_rules.description: Exposed energized electrical conductor in direct contact with pooled water
immediate_action_rules.pattern: exposed bare wire or open live conductor touching standing water

action.banner_message: Exposed electrical conductor touching water observed. Keep everyone away and shut off power at main breaker immediately.
